description: Header file defining callback interfaces and classes for sensor HAL proxy interactions, including sub-HAL callbacks and sensor event handling.

classes.name: ISubHalCallback
classes.description: Interface for sub-HAL callbacks to communicate sensor events, sensor info, and thread status.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackBase
classes.description: Base class for callback implementations, managing event posting and wakelock creation.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackV2_0
classes.description: Implementation of callback interface for version 2.0, handling dynamic sensor connection/disconnection.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackV2_1
classes.description: Implementation of callback interface for version 2.1, handling dynamic sensor connection with version-specific methods.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Posts sensor events to the message queue, managing wakelock.

methods.name: createScopedWakelock
methods.description: Creates a scoped wakelock object based on lock parameter.
